library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
entity top is
  port (
    a: in std_ulogic;
    b: in std_ulogic;
    y: out std_ulogic
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is
  signal wrap_a: std_logic;
  signal wrap_b: std_logic;
  signal wrap_y: std_logic;
  signal n2 : std_logic;
begin
  wrap_a <= a;
  wrap_b <= b;
  y <= wrap_y;
  wrap_y <= n2;
  -- top.vhd:17:12
  n2 <= wrap_a and wrap_b;
end rtl;
